about: A one-dimensional wave-propagation study solved with the explicit two-step MacCormack predictor-corrector method, second-order accurate in time and space, with solutions plotted at several time levels.

features.title: Predictor-corrector
features.body: The explicit two-step MacCormack method: predict with one difference, correct with the other.

features.title: Same setup as Upwind
features.body: Δx = 0.01 with u = 0.09 and Δt = 0.01, so the two schemes can be compared directly.

features.title: Plotted with Gnuplot
features.body: Velocity profiles at t = 1, 5 and 10 s.
